items.headline: Sources: Ex-Colts QB Daniel Jones likely to wait before signing with new team
items.description: If Daniel Jones clear waivers and becomes a free agent, the QB is unlikely to sign immediately, preferring to wait for the right opportunity, sources said.

items.headline: Sources: Colts shut down Alec Pierce for season, plan for WR's return in 2027
items.description: The Colts are shutting down Alec Pierce for the rest of the season and are planning for the WR to return fully healthy in 2027, sources told NFL Network.
